scope: Local Git integration, not cloud deployment or live tester acceptance
integration_changes: Backend actual joins require equal source_mode; UI joins preserve original request scope and reject multiple distinct actual events even when values agree.
Snapshot command receipts come from the latest persisted ACK matching command, run, tester and current status.
Evidence auditors tolerate source-only checkout line endings; C ownership audit accepts an immutable contribution ref. Recorded data/models/outputs remain unchanged.
SYSTEM records merged contracts, B/C non-promotion decisions and observed pinned app startup with live acceptance limits.

checks.limit: Existing vinext static route-classification warning remains.

checks.command: workstreams.prediction.audit.audit(results, report), with pathlib.Path.write_text mocked to preserve the existing report

evidence_limit: Test commands/output observed during integration. Full model training and live transport were not rerun; subagents independently reviewed each contribution.
remaining_machine_work: Verify actual Edge image tag/digest and run the bounded recipe with complete snapshots and correlated anomaly receiver/display evidence.
